description: Happy Horse AI is powered by Happy Horse 1.0 — a single self-attention Transformer that jointly generates video and audio from text, replacing the multi-stream complexity of older architectures. Blazing fast, multilingual, and fully open source. Whether you start from a text prompt or a reference image, Happy Horse AI delivers state-of-the-art results at record speeds.
